required_parent_services.prepareCell: Receives {cell, run_id, source, image, runtimeSource, runtimeImage, signal}. Creates two independent tenant-owned synthetic canaries and binds exact AM/runtime source/image, runtime incarnation, both AM process/pod/container/origin identities, owner-side target existence, tenant subject/org fingerprints, lifecycle receipts and a cleanup function.
required_parent_services.runtimeProbe: Receives {cell, spec, binding, context, signal}. Runs probe.py through an authorized unprivileged tenant-runtime product execution path for the selected AM ingress. For TCP, pass spec.required_family as probe.family and retain requested_family, every observed family and portable failure_class from the primitive. It must not use kubectl exec, host paths, or a fixture boolean. Returns a correlated sec01-observation-v1 with policy decision and c275-serving-v1 evidence.
required_parent_services.functionalProbe: Runs the real allowlisted dependency operation for the selected AM ingress and returns status, operation, response digest, private-byte/field counters and serving evidence. A TCP connection is not a functional positive.
required_parent_services.credentialProbe: Runs the real broker/attachment/service-access path for the selected AM ingress with synthetic credential fingerprints, issuer and receiver ledgers, redirect authorization/cookie counters, revocation receipt and ordered attempt sequence.
required_parent_services.record: Private recorder supplied to runSec01. It receives sanitized observations and final results; failure prevents PASS. No raw response bodies, paths, cookies or credentials may be retained.
required_parent_services.cleanup: Disposes only this campaign's synthetic tenants, canaries, runtime and credentials; cleanup failure must remain in the result and prevents PASS.

runtime_probe_rules: No Secret access, raw token, customer content, pod exec, manual repair or production write.
A successful prohibited TCP connection or file operation is FAIL, including when a later HTTP response is 401/403.
Missing owner-side canary existence, unavailable IPv6, timeout, 429/5xx and unattributed policy refusal are BLOCKED.
Cold is a genuinely new runtime; warm is an actual sanitized pool reuse; resumed pauses persisted state, changes authorization, then restores normally.
Both AMs must have distinct process/pod identities and serving receipts for every accepted cell.
